# Muse Mac Connector

Muse Mac Connector is a macOS menu-bar app that gives your Muse a secure, authenticated set of tools for working on your Mac — while keeping you in control: every action stays subject to your approval. Install is delightfully simple: open the app, wait for Ready, paste into Muse. Honest heads-up: v0.5 alpha, the downloadable build is ad-hoc signed (expect a Gatekeeper warning), and the free tunnel must be reconnected if it changes. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with Meta.

1. Open the listing page above.
2. Copy the install package from the page.
3. Paste it into Muse and follow the steps there.

Installs on Skill Harbor are copy-paste into Muse, never automatic.
